description:
From IMDB: "Three nerdy friends and the school bully must get themselves thrown into detention to find the entrance to a labyrinth of trap-laden tunnels protecting the fabled hidden lab of Alexander Graham Bell."

Huzzah provided a large number of VFX shots including greenscreen work and 3D modelling.
